description: Country-by-country initial police staffing, fleet quantities, replacement values, and crime baselines. World Bank latest-available population and homicide observations are preserved by country and year. All non-homicide categories, staffing levels and vehicle inventories are explicit game estimates.

population.observationPolicy: Latest available non-empty observation per country; each row preserves its year.

homicide.observationPolicy: Latest available non-empty homicide rate per country; different countries may have different observation years.

sources.economy: economy_global_profiles_v1.json (existing local baseline; GDP per-capita and income stress are used only as model inputs)
sources.urbanization: economy_global_profiles_v1.json populationValues.urbanization_rate, otherwise explicit modeled fallback

gameRules.fleetSizing: ceil(activePersonnel / 18), minimum 2 vehicles when population is available; count mix uses role tiers and rounds to exact fleet total
gameRules.baselinePersonnelFormula: population × estimated police staffing rate per 100000; rate is a game-policy baseline, not observed staffing
gameRules.nonHomicideCrimePolicy: Modeled rates are starting gameplay intensity assumptions, not published country crime rates
gameRules.inheritedAssets: Initial fleets are seeded as already-owned starting assets; no purchase debit is applied for opening inventory. All subsequent purchases and hiring are charged to Finance.
